digest.component_or_area: plan review gate calibration and measurement (E3 story)
propositions: Deterministic replay infrastructure (stratified sample, frozen baseline, FP-control pool, clone+strip driver, pure metrics library, golden tests) was designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e3 but intentionally NOT landed on main
The expensive ~450-run live gate replay batch (coarse ~200 sweep plus precise 50-ticket×3 candidate and current fresh runs) was permanently rejected on cost grounds
The verdict-perturbation signal the batch would have measured is now produced at zero marginal LLM cost by the standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder in story d8a5 (change #798, merged on main)
History-mining for ~200 plan-v3 sidecar baselines is infeasible because the impact_model_version bump stranded legacy sidecar data to ~4 rows, eliminating the justification for the live replay
The recall-stripped clone design (copy store, delete *-REVIEW_RESULT.json, run fresh) removes confounds from prior-findings contamination and baseline drift
The two-tier structure with two-level-median candidate↔current pairing and current-vs-current null floor isolates the candidate's true effect on blocking findings and advisory counts
